text:
dave: quick async standup — SLO/alerts pulse
priya: what I did: finished the alert dedupe change for /embed route, deployed to staging. verified no noise in last 6h.
priya: blocker: need a tiny tweak to the alert doc to include the new dedupe label, i'll send a PR
alex: what I did: looked at the /generate tail latency spike from yesterday, traced to a slow redis shard during heavy batching.
alex: blocker: still waiting on infra to rotate that shard, raised a ticket: INC-7892
marie: what I did: rolled canary of updated retry policy for runtime qps, metrics look stable so far :thumbsup:
marie: today: will push the runbook change for rate-limiting fallback and add a snippet for quick triage
dave: note — error budget on route /generate is at ~12% remaining for the week, we should avoid risky changes until it's replenished
priya: ack. i'll hold the rollback window on the dedupe change until we confirm shard rotation
oncall: saw 3 alerts related to high 5xx on /batch at 03:20, mitigated by scaling policy, added tags, no ongoing page
sre-bot: reminder: scheduled maintenance for redis-shard-7 at 2027-06-04T01:00Z, will create brief latency blips
alex: thanks. that maintenance explains the shard behavior. i'll coordinate with infra to confirm times and expected impact
dave: follow-ups: @marie can you drop the runbook diff here when ready? @alex please attach INC-7892 and any flamegraphs
marie: pushing runbook PR now -> https://git.company/repo/ops/runbooks/pull/2345 :eyes:
marie: runbook includes quick query to check prefix cache health:
```
# Prefix cache hit rate (last 15m)
sum(rate(prefix_cache_hits_total[15m])) / sum(rate(prefix_cache_requested_total[15m]))
```
priya: small FYI — I adjusted alert thresholds to use p95 instead of p99 for short-lived spikes on /embed, reduced noise by ~60% in staging
dave: good call. can you add that rationale to the alert's description so future oncall understands? short note is fine
oncall: added note to the alert: "use p95 to avoid transient batching spikes; escalate at sustained p99". also linked PR #2345
alex: opened INC-7892 with logs and flamegraphs, attaching here: https://tickets.company/INC-7892
alex: i also requested shard rotation ETA from infra, they said 2h window, but might be earlier
dave: action items recap:
- alex: follow up on INC-7892 + share ETA (assigned)
- marie: merge runbook PR and post snippet in #playbooks (assigned)
- priya: update alert doc with dedupe label (assigned)
- oncall: monitor /generate error budget and postpone risky rollouts until budget recovers
priya: i have a tiny PR for alert doc -> https://git.company/repo/alerts/pull/198 :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy completed: staging -> prod for ops/retry-policy @2027-06-04T02:12Z
dave: thanks team. if anyone wants to pair on the alert descriptions i'll be around this morning. otherwise i'll check back in at EOD. :coffee:
alex: thanks, i'll post updates to the ticket as soon as infra confirms rotation
marie: merging runbook after quick lint fix, will ping #playbooks
oncall: will keep an eye and escalate if error budget drops below 8%
